name: Babel Brush
description: Manages and cleans up multilingual content/translations.
project_description:
The Babel Brush module for Drupal 10 provides functionalities for searching and deleting source strings. This module includes a form where users can enter a keyword to search for source strings and then delete selected strings from the search results.

 Features 
 
 Search source strings by keyword 
 Bulk selection/deselection of strings 
 Context-aware string display 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Go to Admin > People > Permissions to grant the "administer babel brush search form" permission to appropriate roles. 
 Access the module at Admin > Configuration > Regional and language > Babel Brush.
